definitions.explanation: The act of creating or founding an organization, institution, or system for the first time. Emphasizes the initial creation from nothing, rather than reorganizing something existing.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{学部|がくぶ}を{創設|そうせつ}した。
この{会社|かいしゃ}は1950{年|ねん}に{創設|そうせつ}された。
{政府|せいふ}は{新|あたら}しい{研究機関|けんきゅうきかん}の{創設|そうせつ}を{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: The government decided to establish a new research institution.

notes:
Used for significant, formal acts of founding — typically organizations, institutions, or systems. Not used for casually starting small projects.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{設立|せつりつ} — establishing (focuses on the formal, legal process)
・{創立|そうりつ} — founding (similar to {創設|そうせつ} but often used for schools and companies)
・{創設|そうせつ} — emphasizes creating something entirely new

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{創設|そうせつ}する (to establish)
・{創設|そうせつ}される (to be established)
・〜の{創設|そうせつ} (the founding of ~)
